blocks.text: HOT TUB REMOVAL FAQ
Hot Tub Removal in King City — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost in King City?
a: Pricing is confirmed on site once the crew sees the tub’s size, condition and how hard it is to get to — with no prestige-area adjustment anywhere in it. A portable spa costs less than a full six-seater, and the number covers draining, cutting, hauling and disposal together.

items.q: How discreet is the removal, honestly?
a: Completely, by design. Arrival times arrange around your schedule, nothing is staged where the road can see it, and no client’s property is discussed with anyone outside the job.

items.q: Do I need to drain the hot tub myself before you arrive?
a: No — draining is part of the service. The Live Junk Free crew handles it safely on arrival, and you don’t need a hose, a pump, or any prep beyond making sure the area around the tub is reasonably accessible.

items.q: Is it safe to remove a hot tub that's still wired to electrical?
a: Only once the power is confirmed off. If your tub has a hardwired 240V connection, we ask that a licensed electrician disconnect it before the crew arrives — we don’t disconnect live electrical ourselves, for your safety and ours.

items.q: How do you protect the grounds and landscaping during removal?
a: Deliberately, before anything else happens. Truck positioning and the removal path get confirmed against driveways, gardens and irrigation before the crew moves anything, and the route hands back exactly as found.
